items.label: Inspect the default Backend HTTP server, local host binding, CORS policy, request body handling, and fixture-backed repository wiring.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend `src/server.ts` and `src/http/server.ts` identify which runtime paths are local development surfaces.

items.label: Inspect in-memory and file JSON storage contracts for production-readiness exclusions.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend storage contracts identify transaction, authz, atomicity, and provider limits.

items.label: Inspect PDF export candidate routes separately from the default application server.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend PDF export docs and route contracts identify mounted versus candidate surfaces and production no-go items.

items.label: Define the smallest Backend-owned readiness contract or record an explicit no-go decision.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend docs or tests separate development readiness, integration readiness, and production readiness.

items.label: Return a bounded Project Control evidence candidate without promoting Backend product truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence candidate includes exact Backend commit, path or contract ID, verification summary, and remaining unknowns.
